About JumpCloud®
JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.


About the role
The Enterprise of Tomorrow (EOT) segment is where we win the companies that aren't large today but are on a clear trajectory to become significant accounts — venture-backed startups, high-growth SaaS and technology firms, and digital-native businesses scaling their teams quickly across the US and Canada.

As an SMB EOT Account Executive covering North America, you own the full sales cycle for these accounts: sourcing, qualifying, running discovery, demoing value, and closing. You're selling to founders, ops leaders, and first IT hires who are making foundational decisions about how their company will run for the next decade. Your job is to land these accounts early and set them up to grow with JumpCloud.
This is a high-velocity, high-activity role for someone who thrives on volume, moves fast, and is energized by selling into the North American market. Because you'll be working with US and Canadian customers, this role operates on a night-shift schedule aligned to North America time zones.

lists.content:
• Own the end-to-end sales cycle for SMB/EOT accounts across North America — from first touch to close — with a focus on speed and consistent pipeline generation.

  • Prospect proactively into high-growth startups and scale-ups across the US and Canada; build and work your own pipeline alongside inbound and partner-sourced leads.

  • Run sharp discovery to understand each prospect's identity, device, and access challenges, and map JumpCloud's platform to their near-term needs and growth trajectory.

  • Deliver compelling demos and value-based proposals tailored to founders and early IT/ops decision-makers in the North American market.

  • Manage a high volume of active opportunities with disciplined pipeline hygiene and accurate forecasting in Salesforce.

  • Partner with SDRs, Solutions Engineers, and Partner/Channel teams to accelerate deals and expand reach.

  • Hit and exceed monthly/quarterly bookings targets while building a foundation of accounts positioned for future expansion.

  • Feed market intelligence — objections, competitive dynamics (Microsoft, Okta, Google), ICP signals — back to SMB and segment leadership.

Required

  • 2–5 years of full-cycle B2B sales experience (SaaS/technology preferred), with a track record of consistently hitting quota.

  • Experience selling into the North America market and/or to SMB / startup buyers, comfortable with a high-velocity, high-volume motion.

  • Strong prospecting muscle — you generate your own pipeline and don't wait for leads.

  • Excellent discovery and value-selling skills; able to sell to both technical (IT) and non-technical (founder/ops) buyers.

  • Excellent spoken and written English, and comfort communicating with North American buyers and business norms.

  • Willingness and ability to work a night-shift schedule aligned to North America time zones 

  • Proficiency with a modern sales stack (Salesforce and prospecting/engagement tools).

    • Preferred

  • Experience in identity, security, IT management, DevOps, or infrastructure software.

  • Prior experience in an India-based team selling into North America.

  • Familiarity with the North American startup and technology ecosystem.

  • Exposure to PLG or trial-led motions and to partner/channel-sourced pipeline.

• Bookings / quota attainment against monthly and quarterly targets.

  • Self-sourced pipeline generation and overall pipeline coverage.

  • New logo acquisition within the EOT segment across North America.

  • Sales-cycle velocity and win rate.

  • Forecast accuracy and CRM hygiene.

• Sell a category-defining platform into North America — JumpCloud's largest market — from one of the world's leading tech hubs.

  • Join a collaborative, high-growth team with clear paths into Commercial/Enterprise segments and leadership.

  • Competitive base + commission, benefits, and the tooling and support to do your best work, plus support for the night-shift schedule.

lists.content: Reporting to the Sr. Director of Marketing Operations, this role will focus on designing, building, and operationalizing agentic outbound systems that improve pipeline generation efficiency and seller productivity.

Build Agentic Outbound Systems
  • Design and deploy AI outbound workflows that automate account sourcing, contact acquisition, research, prioritization, personalization, sequencing, and engagement orchestration.

    • Operationalize AI at Scale

  • Move beyond isolated AI experiments by building repeatable, production-ready workflows that integrate across Salesforce, Marketo, Clay, sequencing platforms, enrichment providers, and engagement tools.

    • Improve Outbound Efficiency

  • Reduce manual BDR work through automation while increasing outbound quality, targeting precision, personalization, and activity scalability.

    • Accelerate Pipeline Generation

  • Support the evolution of JumpCloud’s outbound programs through AI targeting, signal-based prioritization, automated enrichment, and intelligent workflow orchestration.

    • Ship Fast and Iterate

  • Rapidly prototype, deploy, measure, and improve GTM workflows with a strong bias toward execution and measurable business impact.

A highly technical GTM operator who enjoys building systems, automations, and workflows that solve real revenue problems. This person thrives in fast-moving environments, is comfortable working across both strategy and execution, and prefers shipping solutions over discussing hypotheticals.

Success in this role is measured by deployed workflows and operational improvements that increase outbound efficiency, pipeline generation, or seller productivity.

GTM Systems & Operations

  • Hands-on experience working within modern GTM systems including Salesforce, Marketo, Gong Engage, enrichment providers, and outbound engagement platforms.

  • Experience building and maintaining workflows across tools such as Clay, Openprise, Zapier, Replit, or similar orchestration platforms.

  • Strong understanding of outbound operations, lead/account flows, enrichment strategies, segmentation, and GTM data management.

  • In-depth understanding of how MCPs work and demonstrated experience applying best practices for MCP utilization and efficiency.

    • AI & Automation

  • Practical experience applying AI and automation to GTM workflows beyond experimentation.

  • Experience working with LLMs (preferably Claude Cowork & Code), prompt workflows, structured outputs, AI-assisted personalization, and integrating AI outputs into operational systems.

  • Familiarity with APIs, automation logic, webhooks, and lightweight scripting to connect systems and automate processes.

  • Understanding of concepts such as agentic workflows, signal-based automation, RAG, embeddings, or AI orchestration frameworks is a plus.

    • Builder Mentality

  • Proven ability to independently build and operationalize workflows from idea → deployment → iteration.

  • Comfortable using no-code, low-code, and lightweight coding approaches to deliver solutions quickly.

  • Strong troubleshooting mindset with the ability to identify bottlenecks and improve workflow reliability at scale.

    • Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Ability to partner effectively with Marketing, Sales, RevOps, and Data teams to align priorities and execute quickly.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

    • Operating Style

  • Highly self-directed and execution-oriented with a strong bias toward action.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and iterating quickly as priorities evolve.

  • Motivated by solving operational problems and building systems that create measurable business impact.

lists.content:
• Purpose: You will directly enable SMBs to secure their modern identity infrastructure, solving critical IT challenges across identity, device, and access management.

  • Growth: Own the full sales cycle end-to-end, expand your expertise in cloud directory platforms, and master cutting-edge prospecting and AI tools (such as Salesforce, Gong, Outreach, Apollo, ChatGPT, and Gemini).

  • Motivators: Join a fast-moving, collaborative team where your direct contributions drive Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) growth, with the opportunity to shape the future of IT infrastructure in a high-growth region.

• Measurable outcomes for the first 6-12 months:

    1. Achieve 100% of assigned quarterly Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) targets through proactive prospecting and closing of SMB accounts in the Mexico region.

    2. Secure a consistent volume of monthly new logos, expanding JumpCloud's customer base among small and medium-sized businesses.

    3. Build and manage a robust, qualified sales pipeline that consistently represents 3x-4x of your quarterly quota.

    4. Maintain high conversion rates from initial discovery/demo stages to closed-won deals by executing a consultative and high-velocity sales process.

    5. Provide highly accurate weekly sales forecasts to sales leadership with minimal variance, demonstrating deep control over your pipeline and opportunities

  • Supporting activities to achieve objectives (order logically):

    1. Engage and educate prospects in the Mexico City area and broader region on how JumpCloud’s Cloud Directory Platform solves critical identity, device, and access management challenges.

    2. Conduct comprehensive discovery calls and technical product demonstrations tailored to the specific business needs of IT professionals and stakeholders.

    3. Manage the full sales cycle from initial contact and qualification through to contract negotiation and closing.

    4. Leverage advanced prospecting, CRM, and AI tools—including Salesforce, Gong, Outreach, Apollo, ChatGPT, and Gemini—to efficiently manage leads, opportunities, and pipeline data.

    5. Develop and maintain a deep technical understanding of the JumpCloud platform, staying up-to-date with fast-moving product updates and AI integrations.

    6. Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Customer Success, to deliver an outstanding customer onboarding experience.

    7. Prepare and deliver accurate weekly pipeline reports and sales forecasts to sales leadership.

• Required Skills and Experience

    • Must-have functional skills:

      • High-velocity transactional sales execution and end-to-end sales cycle management (from discovery to close).

      • Consultative and technical selling to IT professionals and business stakeholders.

      • 2+ years of experience in SaaS companies or Tech companies.

      • Fluent verbal and written communication in English and Spanish

      • Preferred domain knowledge:

        • SaaS, SMB, or mid-market sales environments.

        • Identity, device, and access management (IAM/MDM) concepts.

        • Tools or systems knowledge:

          • CRM and sales engagement platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Gong, Outreach, Apollo).

          • AI and productivity tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini) for prospecting and forecasting.

          • Behavioral or power skills:

            • High-agency self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, high-velocity environment.

            • Strong collaboration and relationship-building skills across cross-functional teams.

            • Exceptional consultative communication and active listening skills.

This is a hands-on role for a classically trained program manager who has already integrated AI deeply into their working life and uses it to operate at a higher level than traditional PM scale allows. You will own the day-to-day program management of the security organization's projects and run a hybrid program management capability where AI handles continuous structured work, while you provide the judgment, prioritization and relationship work where humans excel.

About the team:

Our Security organization spans SecOps, GRC, and DevSecOps. As our scope grows, we are actively investing in modern, AI-augmented operations. As the Senior TPM reporting to the Director of Security, you will own program management across the entire org. You will partner closely with security leadership, engineers, and our AI team, collaborating to design, refine, and drive the AI-assisted program management systems that power our daily work.

lists.content:
• Operating Standard Enforcement: Apply a single operating standard across every security project. Drive project hygiene at scale: ownership, dates, scope, plans, status. Review and act on AI-generated drafts that flag gaps, propose fixes and surface stale work to project owners.

  • Intake and Triage: Own the front door for security requests across Slack channels, ticket forms and direct asks. Classify, route, set expectations with requestors and capture demand as data. Train the AI classification system through your corrections and feedback.

  • Status and Reporting: Produce per-person, per-project and program-level status briefs and the reports the security org commits to (weekly operating reviews, monthly engineering-relevant metrics, quarterly roadmap progress). Edit AI-drafted reports for narrative, framing and the relationship context the data does not capture.

  • Capacity and Commitment: Maintain a working model of team capacity and project commitments. Flag slippage early. Surface overcommitment to leadership before dates slip. Apply judgment for factors the data does not see (team morale, growth needs, strategic context).

  • Interruption Work Tracking: Inventory and measure the categories of interruption work the team handles (elevation requests, threat model processing, team requests, secret rotations, vulnerability alerts and others). Propose new projects to reduce unplanned work and improve processing efficiency.

  • Prioritization: Place new work in the priority queue using stated criteria of impact, urgency, dependencies and capacity. Apply judgment for political and strategic context.

  • AI System Partnership: Work directly with the AI engineering function as an internal customer. File feature requests, validate output quality, define what good looks like and shape the system over time. You are the product owner for the program management capability that supports your work.

  • Operating Standard Evolution: Refine the operating standard as edge cases surface. Propose updates, build team buy-in and roll out changes consistently.

  • Cross-Company Representation: Represent the security organization's program management practice to peers, stakeholders, and leadership across the company. Ensure all program reporting provides an accurate, transparent, and objective view of current progress and risks.

• 6 years of program or project management experience, ideally including time in technical or engineering organizations

  • Demonstrated experience using AI to scale your program management practice. You can describe specific examples of how AI has saved time, reduced cost, automated routine work or enabled you to operate at a higher level

  • Deep fluency with Jira and Confluence, including epic and project structure, JQL, dashboards and reporting

  • Excellent written communication. You can draft a clear executive update, a precise project brief and an honest status report

  • Comfort working without complete information. You exercise judgment and make calls without waiting for permission

  • Ability to push back constructively, including upward, when commitments are at risk or scope is creeping

  • Experience operating in a remote-first organization

  • Bonus: prior experience in security, infrastructure or platform engineering organizations

lists.text: Personal characteristics we are looking for:
lists.content:
• Passionate about AI as a force multiplier, not the primary focus. You have already integrated AI into how you work and can describe what it has and has not done for you

  • Operates from first principles. You understand what actually needs to get done and you do not let tooling distract from the work

  • Emotionally mature. You can hold a high standard, deliver honest feedback and stay constructive when commitments slip or decisions are contested

  • High level of integrity. You report what is true, not what is flattering

  • Ownership and accountability. The program is yours

  • Clear, direct communication

  • Creative problem solver

  • Service-minded. You understand program management is a service function and the team you support is the customer

  • Bonus: passionate about security

lists.content:
• Backend Development: Develop, test, and deploy scalable, secure, and well-documented microservices using Go, Python, and/or Node.js.

  • Auth & Identity Implementation: Write and maintain backend code supporting core Auth/IAM technologies, including OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), JSON Web Tokens (JWT), and single sign-on (SSO) flows.

  • AI-Driven Efficiency: Actively utilize AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to automate code generation, write robust automated unit tests, and speed up debugging cycles.

  • Cloud Infrastructure: Work with containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes, and deploy cloud-native services across AWS Cloud Services (EC2, S3, Lambda, DynamoDB).

  • Quality & Automation: Design automated test cases for both new features and legacy services, utilizing CI/CD pipelines to enforce automated quality gates.

  • Collaborative Engineering: Partner with product managers and senior engineers across multiple time zones to refine requirements, assess technical feasibility, and participate in thorough code reviews.

• Experience: 3–5 years of professional experience in software development, with a strong emphasis on backend systems and API development.

  • Core Technical Stack: Proficiency in Go, Node.js, and/or Python.

  • Authentication Foundations: A solid understanding of modern web security and authentication architectures, specifically OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and JWT.

  • Cloud & DevOps Basics: Practical experience deploying software on AWS and a functional understanding of container orchestration (Kubernetes) or Infrastructure as Code concepts (Terraform).

  • AI Tool Fluent: Demonstrated experience using AI coding assistants to increase individual velocity, track down bugs, and improve overall code quality.

lists.content:

Drive initial engagement, establish a structured partnership model, and lead annual joint partner planning to align key performance indicators (KPIs), revenue targets, and strategic milestones.

  • Sales Enablement & GTM Support: Bridge the gap between partner organizations and internal sales teams. Design and deliver tailored enablement sessions that clearly articulate joint value propositions and integrated solution positioning to create new co-selling opportunities.

  • Ongoing Opportunity & Account Management: Provide continuous field and GTM support for OEM and technology partners. Cultivate deep field relationships with executives, alliance / partner leads and Go-to-Market (GTM) leadership to keep solutions top-of-mind and drive new awareness campaigns. 

  • Cross-Functional Operational Integrity: Serve as the primary internal liaison to ensure seamless execution, lead hand-offs, and compliance across systems (such as Salesforce or NetSuite) between the supported alliance partners and JumpCloud's GTM teams - SMB, Commercial, Enterprise, VAR, as well as, Operations, ESE, Finance and Product.

  • Performance Tracking & Program Health: Monitor, audit, and report on the operational health of your supported alliance programs. Utilize data to identify processes or bottlenecks and implement programmatic improvements.

  • Proven Track Record: Success in building revenue-generating alliances with technology partners while achieving growth targets. Demonstrated ability to execute and support an OEM motion within the Saas / ISV space.

  • Domain Expertise: Deep knowledge of identity, security, infrastructure, and SaaS products.

  • Market Knowledge: A seasoned understanding of partner ecosystems, including VARs, SIs, and MSPs.

• Experience with Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions.

  • Previous experience in a fast-paced, hyper-growth SaaS environment.

  • A self-starter who thrives in a remote-first environment and can work independently across multiple time zones.

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent.
